Memo lifecycle events that dispatch webhooks and their dispatch functions (all defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, called from the corresponding memo handlers):

- memo created (`memos.memo.created`): `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15`, invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`
- memo updated (`memos.memo.updated`): `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20`, invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- memo deleted (`memos.memo.deleted`): `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25`, invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:562`
- memo comment created (`memos.memo.comment.created`): `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30`, invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119`

Convergence point for delivery: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` and `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` funnel through the shared helper `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`), while `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` builds its payload inline; all four ultimately call `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), which enqueues onto the shared `asyncPostQueue` channel. Worker goroutines started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`) drain that queue and call `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`), which is the actual HTTP delivery function (constructs the signed request and sends it via `safeClient`).
